"EGOT" redirects here. For other uses, see EGOT (disambiguation).




**EGOT**, an acronym for the Emmy, Grammy, Oscar, and Tony Awards, is the designation given to people who have won all four of the major American art awards.[1][2] Respectively, these awards honor outstanding achievements in television, recording, film, and Broadway theatre.[3] Achieving the EGOT has been referred to as the "grand slam" of show business.[1][4] As of 2023,[update] 18 people have won a competitive EGOT, and 6 others have earned the distinction with honorary or special awards.[5]

People who have won Emmy, Grammy, Oscar and Tony Awards

"EGOT" redirects here. For other uses, see EGOT (disambiguation).




**EGOT**, an acronym for the Emmy, Grammy, Oscar, and Tony Awards, is the designation given to people who have won all four of the major American art awards.[1][2] Respectively, these awards honor outstanding achievements in television, recording, film, and Broadway theatre.[3] Achieving the EGOT has been referred to as the "grand slam" of show business.[1][4] As of 2023,[update] 18 people have won a competitive EGOT, and 6 others have earned the distinction with honorary or special awards.[5]
